Your menu is free forever on Rumizi — the whole thing, your QR code, your
own domain. What the paid plans add is **the part that answers your
guests**: the diner-facing menu assistant, the workspace Rumizi
Assistant, and AI image generation.

AI menu extraction — reading a photo or PDF into a draft menu — works on
every plan, including Free.

## The plans

<Columns cols={3}>
  <Card title="Always Free" icon="gift">
    **\$0**

    Unlimited menus, categories, and dishes. Your QR code, free forever,
    no scan limits. Your own domain. No AI assistant — guests can read
    your menu, but they can't ask it anything.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Pro AI" icon="sparkles">
    **\$199 / month** or **\$1,990 / year**

    Everything in Free, plus the assistant that answers up to **50
    guests a day** — allergies, spice, what to order — in their own
    language. Weekly and monthly reports on what guests asked for. Voice
    menu editing.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Max AI" icon="rocket">
    **\$499 / month** or **\$4,990 / year**

    For a room that's full every night. Everything in Pro, up to **150
    guests a day**.
  </Card>
</Columns>

<Tip>
Yearly billing is two months free on both paid plans (Pro saves \$398,
Max saves \$998).
</Tip>

## What each plan includes

| | Always Free | Pro AI | Max AI |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Price (monthly) | \$0 | \$199 | \$499 |
| Price (yearly) | — | \$1,990 | \$4,990 |
| Menus | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Categories per menu | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Dishes in total | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| QR code and custom domain | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Menu assistant for diners | — | Up to 50/day | Up to 150/day |
| AI image generation | — | Yes | Yes |
| Workspace Rumizi Assistant | — | Yes | Yes |
| Weekly / monthly guest reports | — | Yes | Yes |

Everything that isn't AI works on every plan: uploading and extracting a
menu, editing it, publishing, translations, open hours, tags,
cross-sell, availability, the gallery, brand images, the QR code, staff
accounts, and your own domain.

## Above 150 guests a day

If your assistant is answering more than 150 guests a day, write to
[hello@rumizi.com](mailto:hello@rumizi.com) and we'll sort out a plan
that fits.

## Your first two months

New venues start on **two calendar months of Pro AI**, free and without
a card. You get the full product — every AI feature — while you decide
whether Rumizi is right for you. Sign up on the 15th, the trial ends on
the 15th.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Sign up">
    Your venue is created on Pro AI for two months.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Build and publish">
    Upload your menu, edit it, publish it, put the QR code on the
    tables. Nothing is gated during the trial.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Subscribe before the trial ends">
    Open **Billing** and pick Pro or Max. Nothing changes for your
    diners.
  </Step>
</Steps>

### What happens if you don't subscribe

When the trial ends without a subscription, your venue moves to
**Always Free**. Nothing is deleted and your menu is not taken down —
your public menu stays live and scannable, every dish still on it.

What you lose is the assistant:

- The **menu assistant stops answering** your diners — it replies that
  the feature isn't available on your plan instead of recommending
  dishes. If you're staying on Free, email me and I'll turn the chat
  off for your venue so your link opens the menu directly.
- **AI image generation** and the workspace **Rumizi Assistant** switch
  off.

Uploading a menu file and extracting it with AI keeps working.

Subscribing at any point turns everything straight back on — nothing is
deleted while you're on Free.

## Subscribe

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open Billing">
    In your workspace, open **More → Billing**. Direct URL:
    `rumizi.com/your-venue/w/billing`. Billing is owner-only — staff
    accounts don't see it.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Pick a plan and a cadence">
    Choose **Pro AI** or **Max AI**, then monthly or yearly. You're
    redirected to Stripe's secure checkout.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Pay">
    Fill in your card details on Stripe. Rumizi never sees your card
    number.
  </Step>
  <Step title="You're active">
    Stripe confirms back to Rumizi and your plan switches over. Head
    back to your workspace.
  </Step>
</Steps>

You can move between Pro and Max the same way — open Billing and pick
the other plan.

## The daily guest cap

Pro answers up to 50 distinct guest conversations a day; Max, up to
150. The day is counted UTC midnight to UTC midnight, and a guest
already chatting when the cap is hit is never cut off mid-conversation
— only the next new guest is turned away, with a message pointing them
at your server. The counter resets at midnight and everything answers
again.

Behind that, there's a spend cap in USD (\$50 on Pro, \$150 on Max) that
serves as a cost guard — almost no venue reaches it, and the Billing
page shows a bar with how much of it you've used. If you do hit the
spend cap:

- **Text AI keeps working** on a smaller, cheaper model, so your
  diners still get answers.
- **AI image generation pauses** until the period resets.

Upgrading from Pro to Max raises both caps immediately.

## Cancelling and card changes

Two things aren't in the app yet:

- **Cancelling** — email [hi@rumizi.com](mailto:hi@rumizi.com) and I'll
  cancel it for you and confirm.
- **Changing your card** — same, email me.

Billing is **USD only**. That's separate from your menu prices, which
you can set in any currency — see [Menu theme](/vendors/venue/theme).

## If your guests don't use it, don't pay

If Rumizi doesn't work for you in the first month, email
[hi@rumizi.com](mailto:hi@rumizi.com) and I'll sort it out personally.
